nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

H3 removes the usual task boundaries between generation modes. Text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame control, and reference-driven generation (character, motion, camera, voice, style) are all handled by one model instead of separate expert pipelines.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the complete 2.18-second opening source segment aligned with 00:00.000–00:02.180 of the target video. It establishes the opening shot, animation style, fighter, rocky battlefield, golden energy, camera movement, action, lighting, and pacing.
<Video 2> is the complete 2.04-second ending source segment aligned with 00:07.970–00:10.010 of the target video. It establishes the final shot, burning ancient East Asian town, dark smoky sky, fires, architecture, magenta energy light, camera movement, lighting, and ending composition.
<Subject 1> is the spiky black-haired martial-arts fighter in <Video 1>, wearing orange-and-dark-blue battle clothing and surrounded by a bright golden energy aura.
<Subject 2> is the golden energy released by <Subject 1>, including its lightning-shaped edges, luminous particles, shock waves, dust displacement, and intense yellow-orange illumination.
<Subject 3> is the burning ancient East Asian town in <Video 2>, including its traditional wooden buildings, curved roofs, fires, smoke, debris, dark red sky, and vivid magenta energy glow.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation] The target video is a 10.01-second audiovisual sequence connecting <Video 1> to <Video 2>. It begins with the complete opening segment of <Video 1>, continues by following the fighter's golden energy as it erupts through smoke and travels across the battlefield, then transforms the energy and environment until the composition converges naturally on the first frame of <Video 2>. The target ends by reproducing the complete final segment of <Video 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> ([Shot 1], 00:00.000–00:02.180): fully_preserved - its complete opening footage, fighter performance, energy effects, camera movement, timing, composition, and visual style are retained.
<Video 2> ([Shot 5], 00:07.970–00:10.010): fully_preserved - its complete ending footage, burning town, smoke, magenta light, camera movement, timing, and final composition are retained.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the fighter's identity, hair, costume, body proportions, pose, and golden illumination remain consistent with <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): partially_preserved - the golden energy retains its shape, motion, particles, and brightness before gradually mixing with red and magenta light to establish the ending scene.
<Subject 3> (emerges in [Shot 4] and appears in [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the traditional architecture, fires, smoke, debris, night palette, and magenta glow converge precisely on <Video 2>.

detailed_description:
The target video maintains one coherent high-energy 2D anime action style with bold outlines, dynamic lighting, layered smoke, detailed effects animation, strong camera motion, and consistent image quality. The transition must feel like a continuous causal event rather than a dissolve between unrelated scenes.

[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to 00:02.180, reproduce <Video 1> completely. On a shattered rocky battlefield, <Subject 1>, the muscular spiky black-haired fighter in orange-and-dark-blue battle clothing, braces in a low stance as a huge golden aura erupts around his body. <Subject 2> forms sharp lightning-shaped peaks around him while yellow energy bolts, glowing particles, dust, and broken stones surge outward. The fiery blue-and-orange sky and all original camera motion, action timing, effects, and composition remain identical to <Video 1>.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.180, continue directly from the exact final frame and motion of <Video 1>. The fighter drives both feet into the fractured ground and releases a stronger pulse. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed as a circular golden shock wave expands across the rocks. Dust clouds rise and partially obscure the fighter while one concentrated golden energy stream tears upward through the center of the frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.150, the camera transitions into a fast tracking shot following the energy stream through dense smoke and turbulent clouds. Golden lightning branches across the dark sky. Glowing stones and embers rush past the lens, creating natural motion blur. As the stream travels forward, the blue sky darkens gradually to charcoal red; yellow particles mix progressively with orange fire embers and faint magenta sparks. The transition remains physical and continuous, without a wipe, fade, portal frame, or abrupt location change.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.150, the camera breaks through the final smoke layer and tilts downward, revealing distant traditional East Asian rooftops beneath the energy trail. The golden stream descends toward the town and loses intensity. Its bright yellow core narrows while the surrounding light shifts gradually through orange and red into vivid magenta. Fires become visible along the wooden buildings, black smoke columns rise into the sky, and drifting battlefield dust transforms naturally into ash and burning debris. The fighter is no longer visible. The camera progressively approaches the exact height, angle, direction, architecture placement, fire pattern, smoke density, magenta-light position, and composition found in the opening frame of <Video 2>.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.970, land precisely on the first frame of <Video 2> with no visible jump in camera position, brightness, smoke motion, fire animation, or object placement. From 00:07.970 to 00:10.010, reproduce <Video 2> completely: <Subject 3>, the burning ancient town under a dark red-black sky, fills the frame as flames spread through traditional buildings, smoke billows upward, embers drift across the scene, and the magenta energy glow remains visible among the ruins. Preserve all original motion, effects, framing, timing, and the final frame of <Video 2>. No additional characters, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, style changes, duplicated objects, sudden morphing, black frames, or crossfades.

overall_soundscape:
The opening retains the energy roar, electrical crackles, flying debris, and heavy battlefield impacts associated with <Video 1>. Across the generated bridge, the energy roar moves upward and into the distance while wind, rushing smoke, falling debris, fire, collapsing wood, and drifting embers gradually take over. At 00:07.970, the soundscape must connect naturally to the ambience and synchronized sound of <Video 2> without a volume jump or silent gap.

non_diegetic_music:
A fast low-string ostinato and sustained brass tone continue beneath the opening energy surge. Percussion grows during the airborne transition, then decreases as the camera reaches the burning town, aligning smoothly with any audience-only score present in <Video 2>.
